summary: Sony's original PlayStation fantasy RPG, reissued on modern PlayStation consoles with emulator enhancements.

entries.title: The Legend of Dragoon

emulation.emulator: PlayStation Classics emulator on PS4/PS5; DuckStation for owned original discs
emulation.notes: Use the PS4/PS5 version for official up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and filters.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PlayStation presentation with official up-rendering and emulator conveniences.

primary.why: The current PS4/PS5 conversion is the most practical official version because it enhances the original PlayStation release with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
primary.how_to_play: Buy or access The Legend of Dragoon on the PlayStation Store/PlayStation Plus Premium and play on PS5 or PS4. Use original PlayStation hardware or DuckStation only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is an enhanced classic conversion, not a full remaster or remake; converted classics may play differently in some cases.
